name: Unbounce
description: Unbounce is a landing-page and conversion-intelligence platform for pages, pop-ups, sticky bars, forms, leads, experiments, integrations, and campaign workflows.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned Unbounce API key, then let selected agents list up to 100 accessible page IDs, names, publication states, and domains. Relay pins API v0.4 and GET /pages?limit=100, strips metadata and integrations, and blocks leads, form fields, users, accounts, clients, domains, page groups, stats, arbitrary API access, and every mutation.

credentialRequirements.label: Unbounce API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a customer-owned Unbounce API key; Relay encrypts it server-side and uses it only as the HTTP Basic username with an empty password.

capabilities.label: List pages
capabilities.description: Use only GET /pages with limit 100 and return minimized page IDs, names, states, and domains.

allowed.label: List Unbounce pages
allowed.description: List up to 100 accessible page IDs, names, publication states, and domains without leads, form fields, integrations, stats, or writes.

blocked.label: Change Unbounce
blocked.description: Publishing, lead creation or deletion, page changes, integration changes, and every other mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Read leads or user data
blocked.description: Leads, form submissions, IP addresses, form fields, user profiles, and related personal data are blocked.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary API access
blocked.description: Accounts, clients, domains, page groups, stats, metadata links, pagination controls, arbitrary routes, and custom arguments are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One bounded page-directory read runs directly. Leads, form fields, users, accounts, clients, domains, groups, stats, integrations, arbitrary API access, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one typed minimized page-directory tool through the encrypted customer-owned Unbounce API key.
Railway mounts one typed minimized page-directory tool through the encrypted customer-owned Unbounce API key.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer Unbounce account, administrator-approved API access, active API key, representative page fixture, account-permission matrix, or key-rotation procedure is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: An Unbounce administrator requests API access if needed, creates or rotates an API key, saves it through Relay Console, then verifies minimized page listing, the administrator-wide permission boundary, rate limiting, agent assignment, credential replacement, revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Unbounce documents API-key HTTP Basic authentication with the key as username and an empty password, mandatory HTTPS, API v0.4 media type, administrator-equivalent key permissions, a 500 requests-per-minute limit, and conventional status codes.

The official API reference documents authenticated GET /pages, a limit parameter with maximum 1000, and page fields including id, name, state, domain, integrations, metadata, and related lead routes; Relay selects and minimizes only the page directory.
